title: FactorMiner: A Self-Evolving Agent with Skills and Experience Memory for Financial Alpha Discovery
abstract: arXiv:2602.14670v2 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: Formulaic alpha factor mining is a critical yet challenging task in quantitative investment, characterized by a vast search space and the need for domain-informed, interpretable signals. However, finding novel signals becomes increasingly difficult as the library grows due to high redundancy. We propose FactorMiner, a lightweight and flexible self-evolving agent framework designed to navigate this complex landscape through continuous knowledge accumulation. FactorMiner combines a Modular Skill Architecture that encapsulates systematic financial evaluation into executable tools with a structured Experience Memory that distills historical mining trials into actionable insights (successful patterns and failure constraints). translated_title: FactorMiner：一种具有技能与经验记忆的自进化智能体，用于金融Alpha发现
translated_abstract: 公式化Alpha因子挖掘是量化投资中一项关键且具有挑战性的任务，其特点是搜索空间巨大，且需要领域知识和可解释的信号。然而，随着因子库的不断增长，由于高度冗余，发现新颖信号变得越来越困难。我们提出了FactorMiner，一个轻量级且灵活的自进化智能体框架，旨在通过持续的知识积累来应对这一复杂局面。FactorMiner结合了模块化技能架构和结构化经验记忆，前者将系统性金融评估封装为可执行工具，后者将历史挖掘试验提炼为可操作的见解（成功模式和失败约束）。通过实例化Ralph Loop范式——检索、生成、评估和提炼——FactorMiner迭代地利用记忆先验来引导探索，减少冗余搜索，同时专注于有前景的方向。
tldr: FactorMiner提出了一种自进化智能体框架，通过模块化技能和结构化经验记忆，利用Ralph Loop范式迭代减少冗余搜索，从而高效发现金融Alpha因子。
en_tdlr: FactorMiner proposes a self-evolving agent framework that leverages modular skills and structured experience memory with the Ralph Loop paradigm to iteratively reduce redundant search and efficiently discover financial alpha factors.
